title: The Roundup

description: No one believes the claims of a young woman (Amber Heard) that a dead patient is stalking the residents of the psychiatric facility.

description: Australian commandos (John Phillip Law, Mel Gibson, Sam Neill) rescue survivors of a downed aircraft on a Japanese-held island.

description: Punk bands protest a nuclear power plant and are attacked by yakuza thugs until a pair of metal-clad bikers arrives.
